functions.name: wilson_lower
functions.spec: Wilson score interval lower bound for a proportion. wilson_lower(k, n, z=1.96): k successes out of n trials. n==0 returns 0.0. k<0 or k>n or n<0 raises ValueError. Formula: denominator = 1 + z*z/n; centre = (p + z*z/(2*n)) / denominator where p = k/n; delta = z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z*z/(4*n*n)) / denominator; lower = centre - delta, clamped to [0, 1]. Tests must cover: k=0,n=10 (lower is 0.0); k=n=10 (lower approx 0.72); k=5,n=10 (lower approx 0.24); n=0 returns 0.0; k>n raises ValueError; k<0 raises ValueError.

functions.name: median_of
functions.spec: median_of(values): median of a list of numbers. Empty list raises ValueError. Even count returns the mean of the two middle values. Must NOT mutate the input list (work on a sorted copy). Tests must cover: odd count [3,1,2] -> 2; even count [1,2,3,4] -> 2.5; single element [7] -> 7; empty raises ValueError; input list unchanged after call; negative numbers and floats.

functions.name: format_duration
functions.spec: format_duration(seconds): integer seconds to a human string like '1h 2m 3s'. Omit zero units, except 0 seconds returns '0s'. Negative seconds raises ValueError. Tests must cover: 0 -> '0s'; 59 -> '59s'; 60 -> '1m 0s' is WRONG, must be '1m'; 61 -> '1m 1s'; 3600 -> '1h'; 3661 -> '1h 1m 1s'; 90061 -> '1d 1h 1m 1s'; -1 raises ValueError.

functions.name: parse_size
functions.spec: parse_size(s): parse a size string to bytes (int). Units B, KB, MB, GB, TB, 1024-based (KB=1024), case-insensitive, optional surrounding whitespace, no unit means bytes. Invalid strings raise ValueError; negative values raise ValueError. Tests must cover: '1024' -> 1024; '1KB' -> 1024; '1.5MB' -> 1572864; '2 gb' -> 2147483648; '1b' -> 1; 'abc' raises ValueError; '-1KB' raises ValueError; '1XB' raises ValueError.

functions.name: backoff_delay
functions.spec: backoff_delay(attempt, base=1.0, cap=60.0): exponential backoff, min(cap, base * 2**attempt). attempt must be an int >= 0, else ValueError. base and cap must be > 0, else ValueError. Tests must cover: attempt 0 -> 1.0; attempt 3 -> 8.0; attempt 10 with defaults -> 60.0 (capped); attempt -1 raises ValueError; base 0 raises ValueError; custom base 2.0 attempt 2 -> 8.0.

functions.name: sliding_average
functions.spec: sliding_average(values, window): sliding window means as a list of floats. window must be an int with 1 <= window <= len(values), else ValueError. Empty values raises ValueError. Tests must cover: [1,2,3,4] window 2 -> [1.5, 2.5, 3.5]; window 1 -> [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]; window 4 -> [2.5]; window 5 raises ValueError; window 0 raises ValueError; empty values raises ValueError.

functions.name: chunk_list
functions.spec: chunk_list(items, size): split a list into chunks of at most size. size must be an int >= 1, else ValueError. Empty input returns []. The last chunk may be smaller. Tests must cover: [1,2,3,4,5] size 2 -> [[1,2],[3,4],[5]]; size 5 -> [[1,2,3,4,5]]; size 10 -> [[1,2,3,4,5]]; size 0 raises ValueError; [] size 3 -> [].

functions.name: merge_intervals
functions.spec: merge_intervals(intervals): merge overlapping intervals. Input is a list of [start, end] pairs. Any pair with start > end raises ValueError. Sort by start first. Merge when next.start <= current.end (overlapping or touching counts as merge). Empty input returns []. Tests must cover: [[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[15,18]] -> [[1,6],[8,10],[15,18]]; [] -> []; [[1,4],[4,5]] -> [[1,5]] (touching merges); unsorted input [[8,10],[1,3],[2,6]] -> [[1,6],[8,10]]; [[5,3]] raises ValueError.

functions.name: top_k
functions.spec: top_k(counts, k): top k keys of a dict of str->int counts, ordered by count descending, ties broken by key ascending. k must be an int with k >= 1, else ValueError. k larger than the dict returns all keys in order. Tests must cover: {'a':3,'b':3,'c':1} k=2 -> ['a','b'] (tie broken by key ascending); k=0 raises ValueError; k=10 on 3 keys returns all three in order; empty dict k=1 -> [].

functions.name: clamp
functions.spec: clamp(value, lo, hi): if lo > hi raise ValueError; if value < lo return lo; if value > hi return hi; else return value. Tests must cover: (5,0,10) -> 5; (-1,0,10) -> 0; (11,0,10) -> 10; (5,10,0) raises ValueError; (0,0,10) -> 0; (10,0,10) -> 10.

functions.name: slugify
functions.spec: slugify(text): lowercase the text, replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, strip leading and trailing hyphens. Empty input returns ''. Tests must cover: 'Hello World!' -> 'hello-world'; '  A--B  ' -> 'a-b'; '' -> ''; 'abc' -> 'abc'; 'a b_c' -> 'a-b-c'.

functions.name: dedupe_preserve_order
functions.spec: dedupe_preserve_order(items): remove duplicates preserving first-occurrence order. Empty input returns []. Tests must cover: [1,2,2,3,1] -> [1,2,3]; [] -> []; ['b','a','b'] -> ['b','a']; [5,5,5] -> [5].
